title: Check yourself: The extension surface and what each piece costs

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A team keeps pasting the same release checklist into the chat. Which feature does the documentation's trigger table name?

options.text: A line in the persistent project file, loaded in every session
options.says: Ruled out because that file is "Persistent context loaded every conversation", not a procedure kept for the moment it is needed.

options.text: A hook that fires on every edit
options.says: Ruled out because a hook fits "automation that must run on every matching event", not a procedure to read and follow.

options.text: An output style that sets the tone of each reply
options.says: Ruled out because an output style is for "a voice, length or format wanted in every response".

options.text: A skill, which holds the procedure and loads when invoked
options.says: The trigger table says "You paste the same playbook into chat for the third time" calls for a skill.

origin.section: Triggers: add a feature when the need shows up

questions.stem: A repository's CLAUDE.md has grown to 600 lines of endpoint documentation. What does the page advise?

options.text: Move the detail into skills, which load only when needed
options.says: The page says "Keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines." and that reference material goes to skills, "which load on demand".

options.text: Keep it where it is, because the file is read once per session
options.says: Ruled out because "CLAUDE.md is paid for on every request", not once per session.

options.text: Turn the whole file into one subagent definition
options.says: Ruled out because a subagent is for "context isolation, parallel tasks, specialized workers", not for reference text.

options.text: Replace it with a hook that prints the reference on every request
options.says: Ruled out because a hook "costs nothing in context unless its output is added as messages", and one that prints the reference would add it to every event.

origin.section: What each one costs in context

questions.stem: Which feature costs no context unless its output is added to the conversation?

options.text: A skill whose description is loaded at the start of each session
options.says: Ruled out because for a skill the "descriptions are in every request".

options.text: An output style that applies to the whole session
options.says: Ruled out because an output style loads "the active style's full instructions" with a cost on "every request".
The table says a hook loads "nothing, since they run externally" and costs "zero, unless the hook returns context".
Ruled out because "CLAUDE.md is paid for on every request", with its full content loaded at session start.
